items.question: When does the beta start?
items.answer: Not yet. We'll email everyone on the list when spots open.

items.question: Do I need to know chess?
items.answer: No. Some moves will feel familiar if you do, and the rest you pick up by playing.

items.question: Is the game finished?
items.answer: No. The core rules work and can already be played online, but pieces and maps are still changing. We'll use the beta to test them.
